assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production square cover artwork for a Gothic music collection, one coherent set matching the supplied three style references: weathered silver insignia, chipped stone heart, black rough stone background. A single large, centered, bold and readable sculpted emblem made of antique blackened silver and dark stone, restrained Gothic thorn details, tactile worn edges, frontal view with shallow dimensional relief. Opaque full-bleed square cover, no transparency, NO rounded corners baked in. The emblem occupies about 65 percent of the square with generous safe margins. Behind it, a beautiful muted colored atmospheric gradient over grainy black stone, subtly brighter behind the emblem and falling into charcoal edges. Fine physical texture, dark fantasy inventory icon aesthetic, like a designed album cover, NOT a game screenshot. Clear silhouette at 56px. NO text, NO letters, NO logos, NO numbers, NO people, NO mockup UI, NO frame surrounding the whole canvas, NO vivid neon, NO pixelation. Preserve a consistent composition, material, lighting and scale across the set. Emblem: one vintage electric guitar fashioned as a silver Gothic reliquary, gently tilted 12 degrees, simple recognizable guitar body and neck, a few delicate thorns around the body. Background gradient: dusty plum, stormy lavender and deep charcoal, soft muted violet light.
